scope: Final MIR append handle-lookup hoist measurements at pinned compiler input head; subsequent PR-head qualification is separate. No global linearity or generated-program runtime speed claim.

protocol.primary_statistic: median of each metric independently; stage medians do not necessarily sum to total median
protocol.calls_scheduling: Original support samples plus two root-serialized repeats per revision. Baseline repeats reuse the earlier interleaved baseline/9b campaign; D4 repeats run later with the frozen final tool. These later baseline and D4 repeat measurements are not freshly interleaved.
protocol.timing_scope: Compiler execution only; native compile/link/run occur after timing
protocol.peak_scope: cumulative native Linux VmHWM, not stage incremental allocation or exact process-group cap sample
protocol.native_exit_evidence: check=pass reflects harness comparison of exact (returncode,stdout,stderr); raw stdout/stderr retained. Separate per-case exit-code files are not retained.
